title: Tamsin and the Tide
author: Zephyrine Kavanagh
blurb: Rafael Dravenmoor, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
